description: Create (first call) or read the SIP address and private trunk credentials for one of the signed-in owner's answering lines, so the owner's phone system can send calls to the line over SIP, with no phone number, instead of forwarding a number. For the line's number and forwarding codes use get_answering_line. Pass the line_id from get_answering_line; a line that is still being set up returns an error. Returns { alias, sip_uri, sip_uri_tls, username, password }; keep the username and password private. The address is created once and repeat calls return the same one. SIP calls use the line's normal balance with no separate SIP charge. Needs lines:manage; rate limited per account.
name: get_sip_address
title: Your line's SIP address
